        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"

            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]

        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Conclusion and Real-world Application", [
            "Geometry links 3D solids to 2D curves.", 
            "Satellite dishes and orbits use these forms.", 
            "Conic sections define our physical world."
        ])
        
        # Ellipse representing the arch/orbit
        ellipse = Ellipse(width=3, height=1.5, color=WHITE)
        self.place_in_area(ellipse, 'B3', 'E5', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FFD700"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00FFFF"))
        geometry_overlay = Ellipse(width=3, height=1.5, color="#00FFFF")
        self.place_in_area(geometry_overlay, 'B3', 'E5', scale_factor=0.8)
        self.play(Create(geometry_overlay))
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#7FFF00"))

        cone = Cone(base_radius=1.5, height=3)
        self.place_at_grid(cone, 'D3', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(cone))
        self.play(FadeOut(ellipse), FadeOut(geometry_overlay))
